title: Sistem Perkongsian Fail Multimedia
role: Sole developer: backend, web admin and mobile app
summary: A media library for event coverage: officers upload photos and videos by programme, admins approve them, and staff find and download them on the web or a phone.
body:
A media library for event coverage, from upload and approval to download on the web or a phone.

Officers file photos and videos under the programme they came from. An approval step decides what is published, and staff then browse, search and download it. One Laravel backend serves two clients: a web admin built with Blade, Tailwind CSS and Flowbite for uploads, approvals, users and reports, and a JWT-secured API for a React Native app built with Expo.

It started as a photo gallery app and grew into a full media workflow, with approvals, notifications, an audit trail and reports.

highlights.title: Nothing goes public unapproved
highlights.text: Programmes and media from officers start as pending. An administrator approves, rejects or cancels them, and the people involved are told in the app and by email. Uploads by a super admin publish directly.

highlights.title: Four roles, scoped by division
highlights.text: Super admin, liaison officer, staff and stakeholder roles decide what each person can upload, approve and see. Review queues only show the reviewer's own division. Accounts created with a system password must change it before going further.

highlights.title: Uploads that survive long videos
highlights.text: Files upload in chunks, so a long event video does not hang on one fragile request. Each file's width and height are stored, read with FFprobe for video.

highlights.title: An audit trail for everything
highlights.text: Every change to a programme, media file or user is written to an activity log, logins are recorded, and each file's download count comes from that log.

highlights.title: Reports for management
highlights.text: Charts of programmes by month, category and year, media by year, downloads, and logins by division, with a printable version.

highlights.title: A mobile app for finding and saving
highlights.text: The Expo app shows programmes in a masonry grid, searches programmes and media, plays video, and downloads a single file or a whole programme as a ZIP. The session token is kept in the phone's secure storage.
